q: 세션별로 평균 팩 전압에서 평균 인버터 전압을 빼면 얼마야?
gold: SELECT AVG(bms_voltage) - AVG(inv_voltage) FROM sample GROUP BY session_id

q: 인버터 전류가 25 A를 넘는 구간에서 보정한 팩 전류의 세션별 중앙값은?
gold: WITH k AS (SELECT factor FROM scale_correction WHERE column_name='bms_current'), r AS (SELECT f.session_id, f.bms_current * k.factor AS v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id ORDER BY f.bms_current) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.session_id) AS n FROM sample_flags f CROSS JOIN k WHERE f.inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT f.bad_inv AND NOT f.bad_bms) SELECT AVG(v) FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2) GROUP BY session_id

SELECT 빠진_샘플 FROM (WITH clean AS (
    SELECT session_id, row_no, stm_ms FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_ms
),
gap AS (
    SELECT session_id,
           stm_ms - LAG(stm_ms) OVER w        AS d,
           row_no - LAG(row_no) OVER w - 1    AS skipped
    FROM clean
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_no)
),
miss AS (
    SELECT session_id, d,
           CASE WHEN d > 15 AND d <= 1000 THEN MAX(ROUND(d / 10.0) - 1 - skipped, 0) ELSE 0 END AS m
    FROM gap
)
SELECT se.label AS 세션,
       se.row_count AS 받은_샘플,
       SUM(m) AS 빠진_샘플,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(m) / (se.row_count + SUM(m)), 1) AS 누락률_pct,
       SUM(d > 1000) AS 멈춘_구간,
       SUM(d < 0)    AS MCU_재시작
FROM miss JOIN session se USING (session_id)
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY session_id)

q: 속도 값이 튄 행은 세션별로 몇 개야?
gold: SELECT SUM(bad_speed) FROM sample_flags GROUP BY session_id

q: 세션 전체 샘플 중에 부하 구간 샘플이 차지하는 비율(%)은?
gold: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(inv_dc_current > 25 AND NOT bad_inv AND NOT bad_bms) / COUNT(*) FROM sample_flags GROUP BY session_id

q: 기록이 1초 넘게 끊긴 구간 중 가장 긴 것은 세션별로 몇 초야?
gold: WITH clean AS (SELECT session_id, row_no, stm_ms FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_ms), gap AS (SELECT session_id, stm_ms - LAG(stm_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_no) AS d FROM clean) SELECT MAX(d) / 1000.0 FROM gap WHERE d > 1000 GROUP BY session_id

WITH clean AS (SELECT session_id, row_no, stm_ms FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_ms AND session_id = 3), gap AS (SELECT row_no, stm_ms - LAG(stm_ms) OVER (ORDER BY row_no) AS d FROM clean) SELECT row_no FROM gap WHERE d < 0

q: 깨진 값은 빼고, 세션별 최대 인버터 전류는?
gold: SELECT MAX(inv_dc_current) FROM sample_flags WHERE NOT bad_inv GROUP BY session_id
